g1_ledger#3.why: Zyryanka coal already goes down the Kolyma on coal barges, most upbound fuel comes in tankers that can't carry coal, and a coal-loaded return hull hits the same shoals, so the barge leg (35% of cost) shrinks only slightly.

g1_ledger#2.killer: removed handling cost vs added hull-year + deck boiler
g1_ledger#2.why: A village a barge can winter beside has no winter-road last mile anyway, so the idea saves only about 1,200 RUB/t of handling and ties up a whole hull for the year at about 10,900 RUB/t.

g1_neg#1.killer: heat to keep a 1 m moat open round the hull
g1_neg#1.why: A bubbler works only on stored heat, and 0-0.2 °C river water holds about 2 days of it against 200 days of ice, while the saving the idea claims (11-15k RUB/t) is really about 1.2k at a settlement the barge can already reach.

g1_rf1#1.killer: coal one 0.8 m hull can hold
g1_rf1#1.why: A 0.8 m draught holds about 1/8 of a village's year of coal per hull, and "full load" at 0.8 m carries the same tonnes per m² of hull as today's deeper barges at 50%, so the per-trip cost does not halve.

g1_mech#3.why: The heaviest unit, not ground pressure, sets the ice season (the same as for trucks), a tractor tows about 73 t of measured payload rather than 200 t, and the only modern costed tractor train runs about 400 RUB/t-km.

g1_rf1#3.killer: summer thaw depth of a lignite face
g1_rf1#3.why: The economics hold at 2.2x, but the face thaws only 0.9-1.35 m, so a village needs about 1.1-1.6 km of seam face a year, and it is not proven that this much exists within 30 km or that the river turbidity limits can be met.

g1_neg#2.killer: ice-edge line load when 2,214 t is loaded into a frozen-in hull
g1_neg#2.why: Only the first trip of the season goes full, which cuts the barge leg by about 17% rather than 50%, and loading a frozen-in hull in winter breaks the ice it is frozen into.

g1_mech#1.killer: share of delivered cost after the barge haul
g1_mech#1.why: Where a barge can freeze in beside the village there is no winter road, so only about 15% of cost comes after the barge, well short of the 65% needed (ceiling 1.17x even if it were free), and the idle hull costs more than it saves.
